_: aina's fixed spoken lines. KEEP IDENTICAL in aina-notch (crates/aina-llm/src/voice_lines.json) and aina-backend (crates/badi-cloud-core/src/voice_lines.json): the app asks for a line by id ("greet.pagi.0") and the cloud speaks this text for free. {n} is ", <name>" or nothing; {wake} is the wake-word hint or nothing.

greet.first: Hai{n}, aku aina. Aku di sini kalau kamu butuh{wake}.
greet.early: Hai lagi{n}! Aku di sini kalau kamu butuh.
greet.away: Hai{n}, lama nggak ketemu. Aku di sini kalau perlu.
Eh, kamu balik{n}! Aku standby ya.
greet.pagi: Pagi{n}! Aku siap kalau kamu butuh.
greet.siang: Hai{n}, aku di sini kalau perlu bantuan.
greet.sore: Sore{n}! Aku di sini kalau perlu.
Hai{n}, sore ini aku standby ya.
greet.malam: Malam{n}. Aku di sini kalau butuh.
greet.larut: Udah larut nih{n}. Aku di sini kalau perlu.
out: Sepertinya kita perlu jeda sebentar. Untuk sekarang, aku belum bisa bantu kamu lagi. Tenang, pekerjaanmu tetap aman. Kamu bisa lanjut lagi setelah jatahmu diperbarui, atau tambahkan kredit kalau ingin melanjutkan sekarang.

greet.first: Hi{n}, I'm aina. I'm here whenever you need me{wake}.
greet.early: Hi again{n}! I'm here whenever you need me.
greet.away: Hey{n}, it's been a while. I'm here if you need me.
greet.pagi: Morning{n}! Here when you need me.
greet.siang: Hi{n}, here if you need a hand.
Hey{n}. Just call me if you need anything.
greet.sore: Afternoon{n}. Just call me if you need anything.
greet.malam: Evening{n}. Here if you need me.
Evening{n}! Just call me if you need anything.
greet.larut: It's late{n}. I'm here if you need me.
out: Looks like we need a short break. For now, I can't help you any further. Don't worry, your work is safe. You can pick up again once your allowance renews, or add credits if you'd like to keep going now.
